Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces a deep eutectic electrolyte using imidazole-amine synergy to reconstruct Mg²⁺ solvation and hydrogen-bonding networks, lowering desolvation barriers. It forms a MgF₂-rich bilayer SEI enabling stable cycling at 60–80°C with 35 mV overpotential. This resolves Mg–eutectic incompatibility, advancing high-temperature, flame-retardant magnesium batteries.
